integrity: The arguments use the original Zorn multiplication over arbitrary fields; exhaustive finite-field tests support but do not establish the general theorem. Pure-null incidence geometry has explicit classical antecedents; complete publication priority is not independently established.
scientific_limitations: The scheme of quadratic equations is not asserted reduced; the theorem classifies only its reduction. No classification of intersection multiplicities, anisotropic octonion algebras, or scheme-theoretic embedded components.
title: Four components and a characteristic-free motivic census of mutual zero products in split octonions
